pages.text: From $(bold)Phase 4$(), food in your inventory gains frost ticks below $(bold)-30°C$(). Colder means faster.$(br2)$(flavor)"Food is only food if you can chew it." ORSA Nutrition$()

pages.title: Stages at -90°C
pages.text: $(bold)Chilled$(), ~12 s: still edible$(br)$(bold)Frozen$(), ~48 s: slow to eat, half hunger$(br)$(bold)Frost-Ruined$(), ~2 min: $(danger)inedible$()$(br2)The tooltip shows the stage. Thresholds: 600, 2,400 and 6,000 frost ticks.

pages.title: Thawing
pages.text: Above $(bold)10°C$() food thaws. It speeds up past 30°C.$(br2)Chilled and Frozen fully recover. $(danger)Frost-Ruined only thaws back to Frozen.$()

pages.title: Prevention
pages.text: $(li)$(l:heating/thermal_container)Thermal Container$(/l): blocks frost$(li)$(l:getting_started/ration_warmer)Ration Warmer$(/l): thaws a stack in 10 s$(li)$(l:getting_started/seafood_boil)Seafood Boil$(/l): no frost while it steams$(li)Never frost: golden and enchanted golden apples, dried kelp, $(l:getting_started/hot_wings)Hot Wings$(/l)$(li)10x slower: raw $(l:getting_started/ice_fishing)late fish$(/l) and Cured Longsleeper
